title: Teinai's Crystals/Skill history
wikitext:
{{Skill history}}

== [[Feedback:Game updates/20120913|September 13, 2012]] ==
*Reduced cost to 5 Energy; increased casting time to 1 second; reduced recharge to 8 seconds; changed functionality to: "Target foe takes 20...40 damage. If target foe has a Water Magic hex, this spell strikes target and nearby foes for an additional 20...40 damage, and nearby foes also suffer Cracked Armor for 5...15 seconds."
